def clamp(value: int, lower: int, upper: int) -> int:
    """Clamp an integer to inclusive bounds; reject reversed bounds."""
    if lower > upper:
        raise ValueError("lower must not exceed upper")
    return min(max(value, lower), upper)

responses.source_text:
import pytest
from subject import clamp


def test_clamp_interior_value():
    """Interior values within bounds should be preserved."""
    assert clamp(5, 0, 10) == 5
    assert clamp(-2, -5, 5) == -2
    assert clamp(0, -10, 10) == 0


def test_clamp_below_lower_bound():
    """Values below the lower bound should be clamped to the lower bound."""
    assert clamp(-5, 0, 10) == 0
    assert clamp(-100, -50, 50) == -50


def test_clamp_above_upper_bound():
    """Values above the upper bound should be clamped to the upper bound."""
    assert clamp(15, 0, 10) == 10
    assert clamp(100, -50, 50) == 50


def test_clamp_exact_boundaries():
    """Values exactly on the lower or upper boundary should be preserved."""
    assert clamp(0, 0, 10) == 0
    assert clamp(10, 0, 10) == 10
    assert clamp(-5, -5, 5) == -5
    assert clamp(5, -5, 5) == 5


def test_clamp_equal_bounds():
    """When lower and upper bounds are equal, any value should clamp to that bound."""
    assert clamp(5, 5, 5) == 5
    assert clamp(0, 5, 5) == 5
    assert clamp(10, 5, 5) == 5


def test_clamp_reversed_bounds_raises_value_error():
    """Reversed bounds (lower > upper) must raise a ValueError."""
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="lower must not exceed upper"):
        clamp(5, 10, 0)

    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="lower must not exceed upper"):
        clamp(0, 1, 0)

    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="lower must not exceed upper"):
        clamp(-5, -2, -3)
